# Better Selling With Bailey

> Owner-run, BBB Accredited estate sale company based in North East, Pennsylvania, serving all of Erie County, PA. Run by Dorian Bailey. A flat $995 fee plus 25% of total sales; the family is paid the day the sale ends; leftovers are kept, donated or removed free.

## Key facts

- Business: Better Selling With Bailey (estate sales, downsizing sales, moving sales, collection sales, estate cleanouts)
- Owner: Dorian Bailey, who runs every sale directly with his helpers
- Based in: North East, PA
- Service area: Erie County, PA, including Erie, Millcreek, Harborcreek, North East, Fairview, Girard, Edinboro and Corry. Larger sales outside the county are considered case by case.
- Price: a flat $995 plus 25% of total sales. A $500 deposit holds the dates and counts toward the $995. The rest comes out of the sale proceeds. Example: on a $10,000 sale the family is paid $7,005.
- Typical Erie comparison: most estate sale companies in Erie charge a commission of 35% to 50%.
- Payment: the family is paid the day the sale ends, with a written statement of what sold and what was deducted.
- Leftovers: kept, donated or removed free. Hauling away large furniture is an optional $295.
- Minimum sale size: none. If a managed sale won't leave the family enough, Dorian says so at the walkthrough.
- Free walkthrough with an honest estimate; written contract before anything happens.
- Sales are held inside the home, so they run year-round.
- Capacity: 2 to 3 sales a month.
- Does not buy estates or items outright; runs the sale so the proceeds go to the family.
- BBB Accredited Business: https://www.bbb.org/us/pa/north-east/profile/estate-sales/better-selling-with-bailey-0141-71145441
- Press: a May 2026 Star Wars collector sale in North East brought in more than $16,000 and was covered by YourErie and Jet 24.
- Phone: (814) 527-1079
- Email: bettersellingwithbailey@gmail.com

## Services

- [Estate sales](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/): full-service sales with pricing, staging, advertising, sale days and leftover removal
- [Downsizing sales](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/downsizing-sales/): for moves to a smaller home or a senior community
- [Moving sales](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/moving-sales/): for households relocating
- [Selling a collection](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/selling-a-collection/): Star Wars, LEGO, trading cards, tools, hunting gear, Harley-Davidson and more
- [Estate cleanouts](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/estate-cleanouts/): how the house is cleared after every sale
- [For realtors and attorneys](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/for-realtors-and-attorneys/): sales planned backward from a listing or closing date
- [Estate sale FAQ](https://bettersellingwithbailey.com/faq/): 42 answers on cost, getting paid, what to keep, pricing, cleanouts and executor questions
